description: Queue creation of 1–100 unique BYOP participants. Poll get_participant_job until succeeded, then list participants. Before creating participants, call get_study, require provisioning_status=provisioned, and verify or obtain explicit approval of the current plan. Carry a trusted unchanged approval forward using study_id and updated_at; changed plan or invitation settings invalidate it. Invitations send unless silent is true.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

external_id.description: Customer ID unique among active BYOP invitations in this study.

metadata.description: Up to 20 scalar CRM attributes and 4 KiB total.

silent.description: Create without sending an invitation email.

name: create_participants
title: Create Participants
